ns2:course.label: Sustainability in Fiction
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in the Sustainability, Energy & the Environment Pathway. Exploration of how narrative fiction focused on sustainability -- such as "cli-fi" (dystopian fiction about climate change) -- shapes our relation to the natural world. Includes experiential learning projects. Topics vary by section.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Sustainability, and Humanities - Lit & Arts course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
